title.value: NL-PS-L1-B - Level 1b: Maximum metadata and empty sections

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 1b test patient, in which all metadata is present, and all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 1b test patient, and only to that patient. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/Nictiz/NL-PS-IG/
